text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Heading out to the track where Kawakami Princess is waiting for training—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer!
I have been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Lately, my energy levels are super-sized!
So, that got me thinking!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking I could adapt PriFai's special moves
and use them in real races!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
First up is the "Princess Drift"!
It's PriFie's signature move, taking corners dynamically and sharply at breakneck speeds!
choice_data_list: Indeed, that was some brilliant acceleration.
Indeed, that was some brilliant acceleration, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right!? Right!?
I've been practicing just so
I could surprise you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Ever since I met you, Trainer, my princess growth spurt has been in full swing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"With my future Prince by my side,
nothing is impossible for this Princess!
I'll be counting on you from here on out as well!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Now then! Back to drift practice!
Faster, faster, pick up the speeeed...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Just like the original work, course-igniting friction heat!!
I shall set it ablaze~~~~!!
